scripts.test: npm run build && cd LocaliserLib.Tests && dotnet test
scripts.upgrade-simplevclib: dotnet package search wildwinter.SimpleVCLib --exact-match --format json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const pkgs=d.searchResult[0].packages; const v=pkgs[pkgs.length-1].version; ['LocaliserLib/LocaliserLib.csproj','LocaliserLib.Tests/LocaliserLib.Tests.csproj'].forEach(f=>{const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'); require('fs').writeFileSync(f,s.replace(/wildwinter\.SimpleVCLib\" Version=\"[^\"]+\"/,'wildwinter.SimpleVCLib\" Version=\"'+v+'\"'));console.log(f+' -> '+v);})"
